Ohio State Fair Boxing Invitational Kicks Off Tomorrow

The Ohio State Fair Boxing Invitational kicks off tomorrow! The tournament, which brings some of the top amateur boxers in the region, runs Thursday, July 27 - Saturday, July 29, and is held under the sanction of the Ohio Association of United States Amateur Boxing.

The action will take place in Kasich Hall at the Ohio Expo Center, located at 717 E. 17th Ave. Bouts begin at 6 p.m. tomorrow and Friday, and at 12 p.m. on Saturday. Admission into the event is free with the purchase of an Ohio State Fair entry ticket. Find out more information about the invitational.

The Ohio State Fair Boxing Invitational is one of three remaining amateur boxing events hosted by Columbus Recreation and Parks Department in 2023. 

Boxing is a great way to get exercise while also learning about self-discipline and sportsmanship. Learn how to sign up for boxing classes.

item.title: Join Us At the Jack Attack Tournament and Legends Showcase This Weekend
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

Jack Attack Regional Boccia Tournament Returns This Saturday and Sunday

Jack Attack Regional Boccia Tournament, the department’s annual Boccia tournament for adaptive athletes, returns this Saturday, Feb. 25! This tournament showcases recreational and world-ranked athletes competing for a spot at the national tournament – and bragging rights! Hosted by Adaptive Sports Club of Columbus, this year's edition takes place at Franklin Park Adventure Center from Feb. 25-26, beginning at 9 a.m. each day.

This event is free to attend – come learn about Boccia, and check out the action! Volunteers are needed to help manage registration, run the score table, assist athletes on the court and with general tournament assistance. If you're interested in volunteering, sign up for a morning, afternoon or all-day shift on Saturday or Sunday

Columbus Celebrates Its Boxing Legends at Barack Community Center This Saturday

Legends, a celebration of Columbus boxing legends, returns this weekend for the first time since 2020! This year, the event honors Gregory Dyer, Tim Bowe and Xander Jackson. The showcase is slated to take place at Barack Community Center, 580 E. Woodrow Ave., on Saturday, Feb. 25.

The event kicks off at 5 p.m. and features a meet-and-greet, a ceremony recognizing this year's honorees as well as boxing bouts featuring up-and-coming local talent. Tickets start at just $10 and can be purchased by calling 614-645-3610 or at the gate on the night of the showcase. 

The Legends showcase is the first of five amateur boxing events hosted by Columbus Recreation and Parks Department in 2023. Learn more about the remaining events and how to sign up for boxing classes.

item.title: Boxing is Back: 2023 Schedule of Boxing Events Unveiled
item.description:
Having trouble viewing this email? View it as a Web page.

BOXING IS BACK: 2023 SCHEDULE OF BOXING EVENTS UNVEILED

Columbus Recreation and Parks Department today unveiled its schedule of amateur boxing events for the year. 2023 will see Columbus Recreation and Parks host a total of five events, which include showcases, invitationals and tournaments. Notably, the slate of events marks the return of boxing to department facilities for the first time since 2020.

The first boxing event of the year is slated to take place next month, when Barack Community Center hosts the Legends showcase on Saturday, Feb. 25. This will be followed by the Hall of Fame showcase at Franklin Park Adventure Center on Saturday, April 29.

Boxing action then moves to the Ohio Expo Center, with the Ohio State Fair Invitational occurring July 27-29. The department is also set to host a Tribute to Muhammad Ali showcase on Saturday, Sept. 30, with the location to be announced at a later time. Finally, the 2023 boxing action wraps up on Saturday, Nov. 4, when the Bill McDonald Athletic Complex hosts the Buster Douglas Invitational.

For additional information on the different boxing events throughout the year, including ticket prices and times, visit the department's Boxing Events webpage.
